messages:
Dana: Heads-up: planning to deploy routing v3 tomorrow 09:00 PT. This includes the observability changes we discussed — new dashboard panels for tail latency, increased trace sampling for the service boundary, and a small alert threshold tweak for 5xx rate. Posting the short checklist below.

Mikhail: Thanks — who is owning the smoke run and rollback?

Dana: @Mikhail can you lead smoke? @Priya will be on rollback standby and has the rollback job ready. Alex will run the post-deploy validation script.

Priya: I tested the rollback script on staging, it reverts config + model pin and drains connections. Rollback takes ~3m in staging, production estimate ~5-7m. I have runbook notes in the deploy PR.

Alex: PR LGTM, CI green except a flaky test I kicked. PR: https://git.redwood.dev/routing/PR/4923 — contains dashboard JSON and alert rule change.

Dana: Quick smoke steps (short):
- hit /health and /api/v1/ping on 3 nodes
- run loadgen 100 RPS for 30s against canary
- validate 95th latency < 1200ms on canary panel
- sanity check traces for KV cache hits

deploy-bot: deploy-schedule created for routing v3, canary=10% at 09:00 PT, full rollout at 09:10 PT if canary passes. :rocket:

Mikhail: I'll be on watch from 08:50 -> 09:20 PT. Will run the smoke script and paste results. Who can add a temporary 95th-lat panel to the existing dashboard? The current panel is 99th only.

Katie: I can add it. Will add a panel named "routing.v3 95th latency (canary)" and link to traces. I'll also increase trace sampling from 5% -> 15% for the canary tag.

Priya: For alerts — current 5xx-rate alert fires at 1% over 5m. I propose bumping to 1.5% for the first 15m after deploy to avoid noisy alerts during rollout. We should also add a temporary suppression rule.

Mikhail: Sounds reasonable. Can you paste the prometheus rule diff here?

Priya: Sure — in PR there's a changeset but paste for quick review:

```yaml
- alert: HighFiveXXRate
- expr: sum(rate(http_server_errors_total[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total[5m])) > 0.01
+ alert: HighFiveXXRate
+ expr: sum(rate(http_server_errors_total[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total[5m])) > 0.015
+ labels:
+   staging_temporary_suppression: "routing-v3-rollout-2026-03-18"
```

Alex: Fine with the threshold bump + suppression label. Ensure ops-alerts channel is aware, and add a 15m auto-remove job for the suppression label.

Dana: Great. Final checklist: PR merged by 20:00 today, dashboards updated by Katie, suppression rule in PR, smoke owner Mikhail, rollback Priya, post-check Alex. If anything slips, call abort.

Mikhail: Will paste smoke output into this thread during deploy. :thumbsup:

Katie: Dashboard panels pushed, trace-sampling toggle created as a feature-flag runbook step. Link: https://grafana.redwood.dev/d/routing/routing-observability

deploy-bot: deploy-started routing v3 canary 10% at 1768728000

Mikhail: smoke complete: all health endpoints 200, canary 95th latency 820ms, errors rate 0.3%, traces show expected KV hit ratio. No rollback.

Priya: Acknowledged. I'll watch for 15m then remove suppression.

Dana: Awesome — thanks team. Follow-up: we'll add a short postmortem checklist item to confirm the alert thresholds were reverted tomorrow morning.
